title: Your first attribute: a customer training note
goal: Add one optional string attribute to Клиенты and save the description while understanding the database-update boundary.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: The example’s customer training note applies across that customer’s requests. A particular request’s channel can differ: one came through a form, another through training chat. Define the new value at the correct level and decide what existing records will contain.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Continue your service in a separate verified copy from the preceding lesson. Preserve the original and completedDT. The example adds a customer note; the independent task uses another document field in a further copy. Before changing anything verify the target and field list. Nexus stores the lesson and your note, but does not operate the external1Capplication.

sections.title: Decide who owns the value
paragraphs: The note describes one customer independently of requests, so it belongs to a Клиенты item. Putting it in a document would give separate notes to that customer’s different requests. That can be another valid need, but is not ours. Do not create another customer entity for one field.

In the prepared structure Клиенты has no custom attributes; Код and Наименование are standard properties. Use Add in Реквизиты rather than Табличные части. A tabular section stores multiple rows inside one object and is excessive here.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: A shared field description is not one customer’s note.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

sections.title: A technical name and readable synonym
paragraphs: Use the technical name УчебнаяЗаметка without spaces. Its synonym Учебная заметка is displayed in the form. The platform may derive the synonym automatically when you leave the name field; still verify it. A synonym change does not alter the purpose or type of stored values.

If the attribute exists from an earlier attempt, inspect and reuse it instead of adding УчебнаяЗаметка1. Prior work and attempt history matter more than matching an illustration. Resolve a different meaning behind an identical name before proceeding.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: An old request’s new optional channel is empty. Was previous text lost?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. The attribute did not previously exist; an empty string does not replace old fields. Verify number, references, minutes and status separately. The new field must not invent a channel for past requests.

sections.title: A string holds text with chosen limits
paragraphs: Choose Строка and length 80. This stores short text, not a calculation, customer reference or secret. Variable length permits short notes while the maximum bounds input. Leave unlimited length disabled. Check the new attribute’s right-hand Длина, not the standard Наименование length in the central editor.

Choose limits from need and boundary examples. Plan empty, ordinary, exactly 80-character and over-limit inputs. Do not promise a specific over-limit message: a form may constrain input before writing. Observe actual behavior and compare the persisted length.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

flow.caption: Explore the example: A field description before a first value
alternative: Owner: Клиенты → One value per customer.
Save: Configuration → Database application follows next.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: A repeated attempt reuses the existing field without a duplicate.
Select УчебнаяЗаметка and inspect its right-hand property palette.

sections.title: An empty initial value preserves existing meaning
paragraphs: Earlier items initially have empty notes until filled. The attribute is optional, so this update does not require rewriting every old customer. An empty note does not mean a missing name, code or reference. Mandatory input and default filling are separate rules introduced deliberately.

Close the object editor and save the configuration. This saves the development description. Database configuration may still differ, with its update command available and a difference marker at the tree. Next inspect and apply that update, then test the form and persistence. A tree node does not prove a saved Enterprise note.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: On another separate copy after the example add optional УчебныйКанал to ЗаявкаУслуги: synonym “Request channel”, variable-length String 40. Save the definition, but predict the four previous requests before updating the database. Rename neither the existing customer note nor customer fields. Apply and verify in the next topic.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author created two new training copies by actualDTrestore. One applies customer note 80; the other adds request channel 40. Saving, restarting and comparing all eight old fields, identities and report 4/120 were performed. Two GUI captures show only saved values. Complete manual attribute creation, 80/81 and 40/41 boundaries, all learner steps, permissions and installer are NOT RUN.

selfcheck.prompt: How does the independent УчебныйКанал differ from the example’s note?
options: Document owner, length 40, synonym Канал обращения
selfcheck.feedback: The new attribute belongs to the document, not Клиенты. Its technical name is УчебныйКанал, readable synonym “Request channel”, type String of length 40, and it is optional. Saving the definition does not establish that the application already has the field. After applying it I expect an empty new channel in old documents and unchanged numbers, references, dates, minutes, statuses and comments. Customer УчебнаяЗаметка (String 80) remains a separate attribute.
